# Tutorials

Welcome! Below is a curated set of step-by-step guides that show common workflows with BergAgents. Each tutorial lives in its own file and can be opened directly from the sidebar.

| Tutorial | What you'll learn |
|----------|-------------------|
| [Quick-start: Custom Agent](tutorials/quickstart_agents.qmd) | Define, register, and run a brand-new agent. |
| [Harness Workflow](tutorials/harness_workflow.qmd) | Multi-step plan → implement → curate pipeline. |
| [MCP Integration](tutorials/mcp_integration.qmd) | Connect external command-line tools via MCP. |
| [HITL Lifecycle](tutorials/hilt_lifecycle.qmd) | Human-in-the-Loop pause, edit, and resume. |
| [Advanced Tool Usage](tutorials/advanced_tools.qmd) | Chain multiple tools, share context, and build mini-pipelines. |

Feel free to pick the one that matches the task you're trying to accomplish, or follow them in order to get a complete picture of BergAgents' capabilities.
